literal: If one asks what is the exalted seat of friendship, it is the state of supporting without wavering, in every possible way.
translation: If one asks what is the sovereign throne of friendship, it is the unwavering stance of propping up a friend by all possible means whenever they falter.
modern: நட்பின் சிறந்த இருப்பிடம் எது என்று கேட்டால், அது சற்றும் மனம் மாறாமல், இயன்ற போதெல்லாம் நண்பனைத் தாங்கிப் பிடிக்கும் நிலையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate height or 'sovereign seat' (vīṟṟirukkai) of true friendship. The poet explains that friendship is not merely about pleasant association, but about being an unwavering pillar of support. The word 'koṭpu' refers to wavering or changing one's mind; 'koṭpiṉṟi' means staying absolutely constant without turning away. 'Ollumvāy' refers to every possible opportunity or means available, and 'ūṉṟum nilai' is the active stance of propping up or supporting a friend when they are in distress.
